# Clipra

> Clipra (theclipra.com) is an AI clip generator. Upload a long video or podcast and get short vertical (9:16) clips with captions for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels.

## Key facts

- Input: upload a video file from your computer.
- Plans (monthly, USD): Free $0 (60 minutes/month, uploads up to 30 minutes, 5 clips, 720p, watermark); Starter $13.99 (uploads up to 60 minutes, 1080p, translation, clip length control); Creator $19 (uploads up to 120 minutes, 1080p, AI reframe, translation, clip length control).
- Privacy: projects are deleted automatically after 24 hours; download clips before then.
- Support: support@theclipra.com
- Start free: https://theclipra.com/signup
